ItemID: 1; Title: LIONMAX #8 x 1-5/8" Exterior Wood Screws, 800 PCS Star Drive Deck Screws, Tan Coated for Outdoor Use, Coarse Threads, No Stripping, Anti-Rust, T-25 Drive Bit Included; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Useful for wood projects, but I already have assorted screws and do not currently need 800 deck screws.
ItemID: 2; Title: kaitnax Human Anatomical Poster Set Anatomy Study Cube Medical Student Learning Tool Anatomy Chart Set, 9 Parts Anatomy Heart, Muscular, Skeletal, Digestive, Circulatory etc. Gift Package 3.9"X3.9"; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Anatomy study materials do not support the repair and fabrication projects I am working on.
ItemID: 3; Title: Digital Clamp Meter MESTEK Inrush Current Meter 1000A AC/DC Volt Amp Ohm Meter Clamp on Multimeter True RMS 6000 Counts NCV VFD LOZ Measures Current Voltage Temperature Capacitance Resistance; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: I would choose this for electrical troubleshooting; it would complement my inspection camera and temperature measurement tools.
ItemID: 4; Title: Marine Heat Shrink Tubing Kit 386pcs, UTCGLAS 3:1 Dual Wall Tube with Adhesive Lined Wire Shrink Wrap Electrical and Industrial Waterproof Tubes Black/Red, 7 Sizes; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: I would choose this assortment for insulating and sealing wire connections during repairs.
ItemID: 5; Title: Buperb Pegboard Wall Organizer, 4Pcs Plastic Pegboards Combination Kit with Shelves and Hooks, Wall Mount Display Pegboard for Office Kitchen Bathroom, 22" x 22" Pegboard Kit without Drilling; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Organizing my growing tool collection appeals to me, but I would check its load capacity before choosing it for workshop use.
ItemID: 6; Title: RIH Air Dryer System -1/4" NPT Double Air Filters-5 Micron Particulate Filter& Air Pressure Regulator - Gauge(0-150 psi), Semi-Auto Drain, Poly Bowl,Bracket - 3 in 1 Two Unit (1/4" NPT); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have no current compressed-air setup or project that calls for this equipment.
ItemID: 7; Title: HJ Acrylic Casted Clear Sheet Plexiglass Sheet Thickness 2mm With Protect Film for Frame, Painting, Signs, Family DIY Projects (8, 8 inches x 10 inches ); ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would try these sheets for small fabricated covers or craft pieces using my drilling and fastening supplies.
ItemID: 8; Title: BOCEUC Silicone Multimeter Test Leads Kit, Banana Plug, Alligator Clips, Tester Hook Tip Test Clip for for Fluke Multimeter Electronic Clamp Meter Accessories; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would choose these alongside a compatible meter because clips and hooks would make hands-free measurements easier.
ItemID: 9; Title: 24x Replacement Trigger Sprayer Nozzles Heavy Duty Industrial Commercial 28-400 Cleaning Chemical / Acid Resistant - Top Squirt Part Lid Only 16oz / 32oz Spray Bottle Glass and Plastic 9.25" Dip Tube; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My earlier dropper bottles do not establish a need for spray tops, and a pack of 24 is more than I currently need.
ItemID: 10; Title: breesky Human Heart Torso and Skeleton Model 3D Model Study Tools for Anatomy and Physiology Students Sets of Three Human Anatomy Models Sciences Learning Kit for Kids…; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am focused on practical tools and project supplies, with no current need for anatomy models.
